title: Configuring RAG Systems: What Breaks, Where Originates, and How to Fix
abstract: arXiv:2610.18567v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a dominant paradigm for improving Large Language Model (LLM) by intertwining it with other components, such as a vector/graph database. Therefore, the resulting RAG systems are often highly configurable, under which a non-trivial amount of failures are related to the configurations. However, there remains a lack of systematic understanding regarding the configuration issues for RAG systems. To bridge this gap, in this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 654 real-world configuration issues collected from 10 diverse RAG systems. Drawing on this, we provide a complete categorization of the symptoms, root causes, relevant stages, and fix patterns of configuration issues for RAG systems, as well as several new observations. translated_title: 配置RAG系统：什么会出错、问题源自何处以及如何修复
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）性能的主流范式，其通过将LLM与其他组件（如向量/图数据库）相结合来实现。因此，由此产生的RAG系统通常具有高度可配置性，其中相当数量的失败与配置相关。然而，目前对RAG系统配置问题仍缺乏系统性的理解。为填补这一空白，本文对从10个不同RAG系统中收集的654个真实配置问题进行了首次大规模实证研究。基于此，我们提供了RAG系统配置问题的症状、根本原因、相关阶段和修复模式的完整分类，并给出了若干新观察。我们的研究结果不仅揭示了配置问题的特征，还将它们与RAG独特的流水线阶段紧密联系起来，例如……
tldr: 本文首次对RAG系统配置问题开展大规模实证研究，通过分析来自10个RAG系统的654个真实配置问题，提供了症状、根因、相关阶段和修复模式的完整分类体系。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first large-scale empirical study of 654 real-world configuration issues across 10 RAG systems, providing a complete categorization of their symptoms, root causes, relevant stages, and fix patterns.
